# Dependent telescopes and affine branch capture

Unchanged Apache-2.0 originals from Bend e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599:
`tests/check/dependent_telescope.bend`, `capture_price_twin_000.bend` and
`capture_price_twin_001.bend`. Derived oracle graphs, text and diagnostics retain
upstream attribution. New tests and adapters use MPL-2.0.

Eight complete definition graphs preserve the eight-field telescope and branch
binder identities. Twenty direct applications have separate typed source callers:
four valid records vary all six unused fields while preserving the dependent
first-field witness; both capture twins use identity/successor closures at zero.
The computed twin's independent `use.go` helper covers depths 0/1/2/4 with both
closures, and `fe` covers those four depths. False witnesses reject. Positive
scrutinees are not fed to the constrained `use` functions with fabricated proofs.

Complete constructor lists, scalar projections and original main adapters have
separate graphs and executable observations. Original builds require Base.
Existing oracle printer/compilation failures remain unresolved; successful
projection does not establish complete constructor-printer parity.
